meta.name: agency-setup
meta.description: Set up a fully functional agent team for any codebase with Agency-compatible structure. Use when 'agency setup', 'set up agents', 'create agent team', 'bootstrap agents', 'add agents to this project', or setting up agent infrastructure for a repository. Creates agents/, shared/, dispatch, tmux config, and optionally registers with Agency dashboard.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为代码库搭建可运行的 agent 团队
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中快速创建 agent 团队结构
copy.tagline_en: Set up a working agent team for any codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly bootstrap an agent team in your repository

howto.what: Claude 会分析你的代码库，然后建议一个由 3-5 个 AI 代理组成的团队，每个代理负责不同的任务（如开发、维护、策略）。你批准后，它会自动生成代理配置文件、调度脚本和 tmux 启动脚本。
howto.when: 当你提到“设置代理”、“创建代理团队”等关键词，或者要求为代码库搭建代理基础设施时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这个项目设置一个代理团队。
say.note: Claude 会分析代码库并提出团队建议。

say.text: 添加一个维护者代理到我的项目。
say.note: Claude 会询问具体需求并生成配置。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes your codebase, proposes a team of 3-5 AI agents with distinct roles (builder, maintainer, strategist, etc.), and upon approval generates agent configs, dispatch scripts, and a tmux launcher.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'agency setup', 'set up agents', 'create agent team', 'bootstrap agents', 'add agents to this project', or ask to set up agent infrastructure for a repository.

say_en.text: Set up an agent team for this project.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the codebase and propose a team.

say_en.text: Add a maintainer agent to my project.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for specifics and generate configs.
